Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Chronic torn ACL. Right lateral knee pain after fall.
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Small joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst. T1 and T2 hypointense 3 cm lesion in the posterior joint capsule, along the posterior cruciate ligament.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Oblique undersurface tear of the posterior horn.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Complex tear of the body and posterior horn with a dominant horizontal component extending to the root attachment. Mild extrusion of the body.
Lateral compartment cartilage: Mild chondrosis with high-grade partial-thickness cartilage loss of the femoral condyle and tibial plateau.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Moderate chondrosis, with diffuse high-grade partial-thickness cartilage loss and areas of full-thickness fissuring in the medial patellar facet

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Chronic complete ACL tear.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: Mild distal quadriceps insertional tendinosis. No tendon tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 13 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1.	Oblique undersurface tear of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus.
2.	Complex tear of the lateral meniscus with a dominant horizontal component and mild extrusion of the body.
3.	Mild lateral and moderate patellofemoral compartment chondrosis.
4.	Chronic complete ACL tear.
5.	3 cm hypointense lesion in the posterior joint capsule, with features consistent with PVNS.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Right knee pain for 2 months after fall. 
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions. Small heterogenous T2 hyperintense lesion at the medial femoral metaphysis, consistent with a nonaggressive chondroid lesion.

JOINT SPACE:
Large joint effusion with synovial proliferation. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Markedly diminutive, related to prior debridement, with extensive complex tearing of the remnant meniscus and maceration of the body.
Medial compartment cartilage: Cartilage denudation in the weightbearing compartment with broad areas of full-thickness cartilage loss, large marginal osteophytes and subchondral marrow edema.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Inner margin tearing of the body and anterior horn. No extrusion. 
Lateral compartment cartilage: High-grade chondrosis with superimposed full-thickness fissuring at the weightbearing lateral femoral condyle and lateral tibial plateau with large marginal spurs.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: High-grade chondrosis with superimposed full-thickness fissuring, most prominent at the lateral patellar facet and lateral trochlea, and large marginal spurs.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Chronic high-grade ACL tear.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Intact. Bowing with reactive periligamentous edema, related to meniscal pathology.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: Mild distal quadriceps insertional tendinosis with associated enthesopathy. No tendon tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 12 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
Nonspecific prepatellar and scattered subcutaneous edema about the knee. Multilobulated ganglion cyst extending into the popliteus sheath. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1.	Severe tricompartmental osteoarthritis, most advanced in the medial compartment.
2.	Markedly diminutive medial meniscus, related to prior debridement, with extensive complex tearing of the remnant meniscus and maceration of the body.
3.	Chronic high-grade tear of the anterior cruciate ligament (ACL).
4.	Mild distal quadriceps insertional tendinosis with associated enthesopathy.
5.	Moderate right knee effusion.

Na seriji MR presjeka lijevog koljena vidi se koštani edem medijalnog kondila femura i platoa
tibije uz potpuno reduciranu debljinu artikulacijske hrskavice medijalnog kondila femura i platoa
tibije te vidljivu manju zonu subhondralnog edema posteriornog dijela kondila femura
(hondromalacija IV. stupnja). Masivni osteofiti medijalnog kondila femura i platoa tibije. Uredna
je morfologija i intenziteti signala lateralnog kolateralnog kompleksa, stražnjeg križnog
ligamenta, iliotibijalnog traktusa, patelarnog ligamenta i tetive m. kvadricepsa.
Blaža mukoidna degeneracija prednjeg križnog ligamenta uz vidljive sitne cistične degenerativne
promjene pri tibijalnom hvatištu.
Periligamentarni edem MCL u sklopu OA promjena.
Kompleksna ruptura stražnjeg roga medijalnog meniska na degenerativnoj podlozi. Vidi se defekt
dijela tijela medijalnog meniska uz ekstruziju istog.
Kompleksna ruptura stražnjeg roga medijalnog meniska (horizontalna i dominantno
longitudinalna).
Vide se fissure medijalne fasete patele koje zahvaćaju >50% površine (hondromalacija III.
stupnja).
Značajno je reducirana debljina artikulacijske hrskavice medijalne i lateralne trohleje femura.
Manja zona subhondralnog koštanog edema medijalne trohleje femura.
Hondromalacija II./III. stupnja lateralnog platoa tibije.
Opsežan izljev u koljenu, dominantno u suprapatelarnom recessusu. Ne nalazi se poplitealne
(Bakerove) ciste.
Edem Hoffine masti - ddg. impigement.
Unutar masnog tkiva, s dorzalne strane distalne dijametafize femura vidi se cistična lezija
promjera 21 mm.
Manja količina lokulirane tekućine unutar lateraelnog dijela m. popliteusa prema
mišićno-tetivnom prijelazu te između m. popliteusa i lateralna glave m. gastrocnemiusa.

intenziteta signala.
